contextTokenMapping.offering_model: Trusted published offering schema binding to one registered model ID. Determines this selected offering variant, not the entire business capability union.

compositionPolicy.SELECTED_MODEL: Eligible selected offering variant supplies primary model when its trusted context.offering_model matches. Business activity union is not an execution list.
compositionPolicy.LINKED_EXECUTION: Resolve the selected child offering in its own scope with parent linkage; no automatic child booking, charge or duplicate parent allocation. Parent accepted command owns instantiation.
